scheme_name: Special Education And Vocational Training Through Government Institutions
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra
Applicant must be a person with disability having at least 40% disability
Applicable disability types include visual impairment, hearing impairment, orthopaedic handicap, etc.
benefits_summary: Free education, food, shelter, clothing and vocational training are provided to eligible children with disability.
